newsitem.title: USA: HFS Inc in 5-year alliance with Caribiner.
newsitem.headline: HFS Inc in 5-year alliance with Caribiner.

text.p: HFS Inc said Thursday it has entered into a five year preferred alliance with Caribiner Inc, a subsidiary of Caribiner International Inc.

HFS said Caribiner will handle substantially all of the annual conferences for the hotels, real estate operations and resort operations comprising HFS Inc, as well as its Avis rental car system. The company said Carbinier will also handle audio-visual equipment rental and outsourcing services.
Previously, said the company, Caribiner was producing about 25 percent of all HFS conferences.
The terms of the alliance were not disclosed.
Caribiner is a producer of meetings, events and training programs, and provides of related business communications services.

HFS is a franchisor of hotels and residential real estate brokerage offices, and owns Avis Inc and Resort Condominiums International Inc, a provider of vacation timeshare exchanges. HFS has a pending merger with PHH Corp.
